name: mado-app
description: 新幹線の窓 (michikusa-travel.com) — static site build and validation entry points.
//type: Intentionally NOT "module". app/*.js are browser scripts loaded by the generators via vm.runInNewContext (sloppy-mode script semantics); leaving the default keeps `node --check` faithful to that. The build/validate scripts are .mjs and are ESM regardless.

scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:pages
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:content && npm run check:timetable && npm run check:spot-pages && npm run check:language && npm run check:ui-strings && npm run check:727 && npm run check:sparkling
scripts.check:syntax: node --check data.js && node --check app.js && node --check track.js && node --check spot-page-shared.js && node --check data/timetable.js && node --check live/live.js
